channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: PM Modi says he forgives students for abusive remarks: ‘Let’s guide the misguided’
item.description: Prime Minister Modi said the language used by some protesters ‘would not suit any civilised society’, but appealed to people to help reform the students instead of seeking retribution.

item.title: 1 dead, another injured in terror attack in J&K's Kulgam; terrorists target non-local labourers
item.description: A Chhattisgarh labourer was killed and another injured in a terrorist attack at a brick kiln in Kulgam, Jammu and Kashmir. Deepak Ratray, 24, died from his injuries, while Bopinder, 28, is hospitalised. The attack follows recent violence against non-local workers in the region.

item.title: Spider-Man ending explained: Spoiler alert; here's what the post-credits scene means and more
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day ends with Peter reconnecting with Ned, MJ drawn to her broken necklace and a post-credits scene hinting at a Spider-Man beyond Earth.

item.title: Trump’s $100,000 H-1B Visa Fee: Will it crush the American dream for Indian students? Here's what experts say
item.description: The proposed $100,000 fee hurts the Return on Investment (ROI) for these degrees. Experts tell LiveMint that students already stretch their budgets for US tuition and living costs, and adding a premium just for the right to work may make the financial proposition mathematically difficult for most.&nbsp;

item.title: IMD sees below-normal August-September rains, reviving inflation fears
item.description: After July's modesrecovery from a weak June, the weather office has forecast below-normal rainfall for the rest of the monsoon season, raising concerns over kharif crops, food inflation and rural demand.

item.title: Eric Trump-backed defense technology company Space-Eyes to go public in $638 million SPAC deal
item.description: SPACEEYES-IPO-ERIC-TRUMP: Eric Trump-backed defense technology company Space-Eyes to go public in $638 million SPAC deal

item.title: Jaishankar speaks to Iran FM Araghchi, urges no attacks on commercial shipping and seafarers amid West Asia tensions
item.description: S Jaishankar, in conversation with Iranian counterpart, stated he strongly urged that commercial shipping and seafarers must not be targeted under any circumstances, reiterating that India condemns any such attacks regardless of who carries them out.

item.title: PM Modi, UK PM Burnham commit to harnessing full potential of mega trade deal for ‘shared prosperity’
item.description: In their first phone call after Burnham became the prime minister on July 20, succeeding Keir Starmer, the two leaders covered key aspects of bilateral ties.

item.title: Parents pay ₹8.2 crore for secret gene experiment; daughter dies: Lead doctor gets away with informal verbal counselling
item.description: Investigating is ongoing over a girl's death during a gene-editing trial. The incident, which raised ethical concerns, is being examined after severe complications led to the girl's death.

item.title: India slams Islamabad over PoJK crackdown: ‘Pakistan-trained Mujahideen sent to India now turning against state’
item.description: India's Ministry of External Affairs criticised Pakistan for its response to protests in PoJK, referencing a Pakistani official's admission that Mujahideen groups trained by the state now pose internal challenges. Over 40 have died during the crackdown on demonstrators.

item.title: Explained: Why is Spain's Ceuta witnessing massive migrant influx from Morocco
item.description: Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez visited Ceuta on Friday and condemned the border breach which he described as 'a violation of Spain's territorial integrity' as thousands of migrants entered the city from Morocco.

item.title: Bengaluru woman alleges harassment by Zepto delivery person who wanted to enter her home ‘for 5 minutes’
item.description: The woman said Zepto had “issued a restraining order against the driver,” preventing him from coming near her house, and had “terminated his ID”.

item.title: Weather update: IMD forecasts below-normal rain in August-September; Orange alert in Himachal, Kerala
item.description: The weather agency said rainfall across the country during these two months is expected to remain below 94% of the Long Period Average (LPA), indicating weaker-than-usual monsoon activity in the latter half of the season

item.title: Netflix sued for $105 million after master copy of Nicolas Cage’s WWII film ‘Fortitude’ is allegedly stolen
item.description: Netflix is facing a $105 million lawsuit after an unencrypted master copy of the unreleased Nicolas Cage film ‘Fortitude’ was allegedly stolen from its Los Angeles office.&nbsp;

item.title: Life term for ex-AAP leader Tahir Hussain in Delhi riots case; why city court ruled out death penalty
item.description: A Delhi court sentenced former AAP councillor Tahir Hussain and four others to life imprisonment for the 2020 murder of IB officer Ankit Sharma during riots. The judge indicated that the case was not severe enough for the death penalty, citing potential for reform.

item.title: Ram Mandir donation row: Rahul Gandhi makes a cameo in Pappu Yadav's 'Chanda Chori' skit at Parl complex — watch video
item.description: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi joined the demonstration. The INDIA bloc lawmakers sought the resignation of Home Minister Amit Shah and slammed his absence from the proceedings in Parliament.

item.title: Murder of Suvendu Adhikari’s aide: CBI arrests 2 suspects, allegedly linked to rival political party
item.description: The CBI arrested brothers Sagar and Sahib Sonkar in connection to the assassination of Chandranath Rath, aide to West Bengal's Chief Minister.

item.title: Companies step up efforts to curb supply chain emissions as focus shifts to Scope 3 decarbonization
item.description: At the Mint Sustainability Summit 2026, corporate sustainability leaders said supplier collaboration, access to finance and better data will be crucial as companies shift their net-zero focus to tackling Scope 3 emissions.

item.title: IMD weather forecast for Saturday, 1 August: Heavy rain to lash several states; flash flood risk in Gujarat, MP
item.description: Heavy to extremely heavy rainfall is expected in several states on August 1, warned the IMD. Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan may experience intense downpours, leading to waterlogging and flash floods. Residents are advised to stay alert for potential disruptions in affected areas.

item.title: Why was Raghav Chadha silent on student protest? BJP MP’s justification fails to impress social media; memes galore
item.description: Critics slam Raghav Chadha for abandoning students after joining the BJP, calling it a betrayal of his former stance. Despite his promise for solutions, discontent continues on social media.

item.title: SC asks Centre to appoint nodal officer, assist families killed or missing in Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: The SC asked the MEA to assist affected families in filing compensation claims before the Russian Embassy here and to provide all relevant information and updates in vernacular languages.

item.title: Meat shops in Muzaffarnagar along Kanwar Yatra 2026 route to remain shut till August 12; liquor stores to operate
item.description: With lakhs of devotees, either local or in transit, expected to pass through Uttar Pradesh, authorities have rolled out extensive security and logistical measures for the Kanwar Yatra.

item.title: China landslide death toll climbs to 51 as search continues for 10 missing in Chongqing
item.description: The tragedy struck Pengshui County on July 17, when a massive collapse of rocks and earth crashed onto residential buildings along the banks of the Wujiang River, burying homes and trapping dozens of people beneath the debris

item.title: Pakistan signals invitation to PM Modi for SCO Summit 2027 in Islamabad, says ‘this is an obligation on….’
item.description: Amid ongoing tensions with India, Pakistan has indicated that Prime Minister Narendra Modi will be invited to the 2027 SCO Summit in Islamabad, emphasising that all member nations will receive invitations in accordance with protocol.

item.title: Drama at Parliament: MP Pappu Yadav turns sadhu — Watch opposition leaders staging Ram Mandir donation ‘theft’ issue
item.description: In a theatrical protest outside Parliament, Opposition MPs highlighted alleged embezzlement of Ram Temple donations. Prominent leaders used street play to raise the issue.

item.title: Who is Taslima Nasreen? Why is the Bangladeshi author’s return to Kolkata after 19 years relevant in Bengal politics?
item.description: Taslima Nasreen returns to Kolkata after 19 years, describing it as an emotional homecoming. Her visit precedes a politically significant literary event focused on anti-fundamentalism.

item.title: ‘Both have embraced freedom’: SC clears Omar Abdullah's divorce from estranged wife Payal
item.description: A Bench of Justice PS Narasimha and Justice Alok Aradhe disposed of the appeal after Senior Advocate Kapil Sibal, appearing for Omar Abdullah, informed the Court that all disputes between the parties had been amicably resolved, legal news website Bar and Bench reported.

item.title: Bengaluru's Visa manager loses job in latest round of layoffs despite ‘outstanding performance reviews’
item.description: Bengaluru's Visa manager lost his job in latest round of layoffs despite ‘outstanding performance reviews’. The company cut 7% of its workforce amid restructuring efforts, sparking discussions online.

item.title: PM Modi congratulates Lovepreet Singh for silver medal win at CWG 2026 — ‘His dedication, determination are admirable’
item.description: Lovepreet Singh delivered a strong performance and finished with a total of 388kg. He came agonisingly close to gold, missing it by just one kilogram.

item.title: CJP protest: Families of injured policemen share their side of story— ‘My father was dragged’, ‘uniform soaked in blood’
item.description: The family members of Delhi Police personnel who sustained injuries during the 20 July 'Sansad Chalo' protest march held a press conference on Friday to discuss their ordeal and the impact of the incident on their lives.

item.title: Pakistan avalanche: 4 bodies recovered after Broad Peak disaster, Nirmal Purja among 10 climbers missing
item.description: The Alpine Club of Pakistan launched search-and-rescue operations after an avalanche struck Broad Peak, recovering four bodies. Helicopter support depends on weather conditions. Notable missing climbers include Nirmal Purja.&nbsp;

item.title: CJP protest: Daughter of UP BJP leader says Pralhad Joshi appointed as education minister feels like ‘bleak joke’
item.description: CJP Protest: “The person who's been appointed as education minister now... honestly, it feels like a very, very bleak joke,” Yashaswinee Raje Singh said in an interview.

item.title: Bhiwandi building collapse: Nine dead, official says building was old, declared ‘structurally unsafe’ | Top updates
item.description: Thane collector Shrikrishnanath B. Panchal said on Friday, “So far, the bodies of nine people have been recovered. Initial information suggested that around 10 to 12 people were trapped inside.”

item.title: US weighs steep $100,000 fee for international students seeking jobs after graduation, Wall Street Journal reports
item.description: Tech companies, which carry out their recruitments in US universities are where most of the foreign workforce ply their trade. These companies had opposed the $100,000 fees on H1B visas.

item.title: After FIFA World Cup criticism, Argentina bans foreigners accused of spreading anti-Argentina hate
item.description: President Javier Milei signed an emergency decree prohibiting the entry of foreigners accused of inciting hatred against Argentina. The decree is intended to protect national pride amid ongoing diplomatic tensions and criticism of the Argentine football team following the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
